scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix client && npm test --prefix server
scripts.audit: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix server --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix client --omit=dev --audit-level=high
